values.title: Deploying FIPS-Certified YubiKeys: SCP11, AAL3, and Compliant Initialization
values.description: FIPS mandate? Configure and initialize YubiKeys in FIPS-approved mode with SCP11, crypto officer setup, and auditable procedures an auditor can verify.
values.prerequisite: Comfortable with PKI concepts and enterprise device management. No prior FIPS or SCP11 experience needed.
